title: T8 HTTP cost API: channel, turn, organization rollup, compare, export
description: Depends on T4 and T7. Files: new conversation/src/http/routes/costs.ts, conversation/src/http/app.ts, new conversation/src/domain/costs.ts. Routes: GET /orgs/{t}/channels/{c}/cost, /turns/{id}/cost, /costs?group_by=, /costs/export?format=csv|ndjson, /costs/compare. Authorization per the owner's answer to question 4 of the plan. Acceptance: plan scenarios 17, 18, 21, 22, 23 pass; features/cost_api.feature in cucumber-features.txt.

comments.text: T8 implemented in PR 541 (ts/cost-http-api): read-only cost API (turn, message, channel, org rollup by bot/channel/member/model/day/month, turn rows, compare, export), zod schemas in host-protocol/src/costs.ts, contract in docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md 3.10. Decision: every enabled member of the org reads org cost; non-members and other tenants refused; no GSI. Gherkin cost_api.feature and cost_api_gateway_rows.feature (failed first, 4 mutation checks caught), vitest 1225 passed. No IAM change; verify with the IAM simulator and a real call after deploy. Awaiting review and CI.
